firm_data.firm_description: Gibney, Anthony & Flaherty, LLP is a full-service commercial law firm with offices in New York and San Francisco, and associated offices in London, Geneva and Singapore. They provide turn-key solutions and offer a hands-on approach.
notable_facts: A member of IGAL, the Intercontinental Grouping of Accountants and Lawyers
The firm has been in operation for over 70 years
A large percentage of their legal team has spent their entire careers at Gibney

email.subject: AI for Gibney, Anthony & Flaherty, LLP - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Bradford,

As CIO of an 82-attorney firm spanning New York, San Francisco, and international offices, you're likely balancing turn-key solutions with operational efficiency across multiple jurisdictions. That's exactly the challenge we see firms like yours facing.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of mid-market practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping firms like Gibney compete with BigLaw. I'd be happy to stop by your office to walk through a 20-minute demo.

Worth a conversation?

Vasu
Lucio
